recentItems.title: What to know after Army blows up toxic bomb-making material in Iowa
recentItems.description:
The Army detonated nearly five tons of degraded chemicals in Iowa Wednesday, with President Trump and military officials calling the operation a success. 
 
But scientists are now testing to determine whether residents are safe. 
 
ABC News' Alex Perez reports.
